_comment: The rate-limit and progress seams of the sequential transfer, after the staging cut split _http_download into a wrapper of closures plus _http_download_claimed. Every anchor is structural -- call names and identifiers only, no assignment, no quoted or numeric value -- so the row357 classifier reads them all as STABLE without a producer record. M1 is the exact mutation that ESCAPED the retired source-text gate: it deletes the only live acquire, and the old test stayed green because the literal survived in the wrapper's closure. Each anchor is a newline-delimited whole line, because the bare call text also occurs in the closure's own def line and would match twice. M4 pushes the other way: an extra defensive acquire the transfer never gives back, which the same exact-count gate must refuse while the progress and resume bandmates stay green.
subject: the sequential HTTP transfer takes exactly one rate-limit slot before the stream opens, gives exactly one back however the stream ends, and reports absolute progress -- proved by running it, not by reading its source

mutants.label: M1 switch off per-domain rate limiting by deleting the only live acquire
M2 leak the slot by never returning it to the limiter
M3 stop reporting sequential transfer progress to the liveness seam
M4 over-correct into a defensive second acquire the transfer never gives back
